title_zh: 选择旁听修道院讲道而不捐献

scenario.label_zh: 选择旁听修道院讲道而不捐献
scenario.goal_zh: 询问修道院开放活动的讲道与捐献安排，并确认可以坐在后排旁听

context_zh: 游客向虚构修道院的访客接待员询问当日对外开放的活动。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Rafael
sentences.text: The notice says a monk will preach at eleven. May visitors sit in, or is it only for the community here?

sentences.speaker: Beatrice
sentences.text: Visitors are welcome. People can leave an offering afterward, but giving is entirely optional.

sentences.speaker: Rafael
sentences.text: I’d like to listen without taking part in the collection. Is that all right?

sentences.speaker: Beatrice
sentences.text: Certainly. You can sit in the back row, and no one will expect you to give anything.

sentences.speaker: Rafael
sentences.text: Thank you. I’ll sit there and listen.
